stem: Which person is working like a scientist?

options.text: Dr. Rao, a well-known scientist, guesses which switch in his lab is faulty without testing anything
Rohan repairs his bicycle by trying the very first idea that comes into his mind
Meena finishes her maths homework quickly by copying the method her teacher showed on the board
Sunita, while baking at home, changes the amount of yeast one spoon at a time and records how high the dough rises each time

teacher.key_rationale: A person works like a scientist when they follow the scientific method — changing one variable, observing, and recording — to solve a problem, regardless of place or job title. Only Sunita (D) does this. A traps students who equate a scientist's job title with doing science (no testing occurs). B and C trap students who think solving any daily-life problem or completing schoolwork counts as scientific work, since no methodical testing is involved.
